title: kit.diagram.v1
description: The machine-readable header of every diagram source: the first-class `%% kit:diagram {...}` comment on the line after the theme's init line, in every docs/diagrams/*.mmd and every ```mermaid block in Markdown (docs/DIAGRAMS.md, the lineage rule). It gives the diagram a stable project-prefixed id, its lineage (what it derives from, what it supersedes, its version), its relationships to other diagrams, and the things it depicts (each with a path that must exist). `kit diagrams check` validates it; the index and the lineage graph are generated from it.

id.description: Stable, project-prefixed, dot-namespaced, unique across the repository, e.g. saasreport.terminal.arch. The prefix is the project code.

project.description: The project the diagram belongs to: the short code of its registry entry (packages/core/registry/projects.json, the `short` without the dash, or the key when there is none), or kit.

summary.description: One or two sentences for the generated index.

derives_from.description: Diagram ids this one is derived from (in this repository or declared in docs/diagrams/externals.json), or https URLs of external sources. Empty when it derives from nothing.

ref.description: What is shown: a contract id, a worker name, a migration name, a package name, a file.

reviewed.description: The date a person last checked the header against what the diagram shows. Every header is complete: there is no stub or needs-review state, and a diagram whose header is not complete fails `kit diagrams check`. The one exception is the generated lineage graph, which carries `generated` instead.

generated.description: Only the generated lineage graph (docs/diagrams/lineage.mmd) carries this: it is derived from the other headers by `kit diagrams render` and never edited by hand.
